close_reason: Conversation lifecycle implementation complete; targeted validation and mix q pass. Full precommit only has a confirmed unrelated flaky peer timeout.
description: GitHub #768. Make conversation persistence and agent memory communication-channel-centric so Mattermost and other room-based providers isolate each user per connector/channel/thread. Identity dimensions: provider + connector configuration + external channel + external user + stable external thread/root ID when present. Persist channel and thread separately for aggregation. Channel-level and threaded conversations remain separate; different threads/users isolate. Root post remains in channel history; first threaded reply starts fresh thread history. Preserve email threading, BO sessions, workflow scopes, and legacy mixed rows; new scoped conversations must not reuse legacy history. Dependency graph: identity -> persistence -> agent history -> validation.

comments.text: Architecture revised: Engine persists the incoming user message before Agent execution, passes explicit conversation/message refs, Agent retains execution data in memory, and Engine finalizes success or handled failure by user-message ID. Supersedes communication identity encoded in runtime scope strings; no attempt model or per-turn trace writes.

Action reuse evidence: extended existing Engine Conversations context and Engine/NodeRouter boundary for admission/finalization; reused existing Message trace and MessageTraceArtifact persistence. Conversation binding is local-only trusted lifecycle data and is not registered/exposed as an Agent Action. Existing conversation.persist_message_history remains for agent-initiated standalone history writes and was not duplicated.
